cells.title: Safe to spend replayed on past paydays
cells.code:
PENSION = (me.get("age") or 0) >= 68
PAY = "pension day" if PENSION else "payday"
PAY_TO = "pension day" if PENSION else "payday"
CYCLE = "pension cycle" if PENSION else "pay cycle"
def day(s):
    d = datetime.date.fromisoformat(str(s)[:10])
    return f"{d.day} {d:%b}"
emit("pay_word", PAY, "text", "The day money comes in")
emit("pay_to", PAY_TO, "text", "The day money comes in")

r = kori.replay()
months = [{"label": c["label"], "state": c["state"], "safe": c.get("safe")} for c in r.get("cells") or []]
miss = r.get("miss") or {}
if r.get("checked") and months:
    emit("checked", r["checked"], "count", "Past paydays tested")
    emit("held", r["held"], "count", "Times the number held")
    emit("missed", r["missed"], "count", "Times it missed")
    emit("balance_as_budget_held", r["balance_as_budget_held"], "count", "Times the balance as budget would have held")
    emit("summary", r["summary"], "text", "In short")
    emit("method", r["method"], "text", "How it was tested")
    emit("miss_title", miss.get("window") or r["summary"], "text", "When it missed")
    emit("miss_text", miss.get("text") or r["summary"], "text", "What happened")
    emit("miss_lesson", " ".join(x for x in (miss.get("lesson"), miss.get("since")) if x) or r["summary"], "text", "What changed since")
    table("months", months, "Month by month")
    short = r["short"].replace(f" {r['held']} times", f" **{r['held']} times**", 1)
    if "**" not in short:
        short = f"**{short}**"
    say(f"{short}. {r['versus']}")
